Wiggle & Snug is a brand exclusive to **Target**.

Target's primary rewards program is the **Target RedCard** (which comes as a debit card or credit card). With a RedCard, you don't earn "points" in the traditional sense that accumulate. Instead, you receive an **immediate 5% discount** on most purchases, including Wiggle & Snug products, when you use your RedCard.

So, effectively, you save **5 cents per dollar** spent on Wiggle & Snug products when using a Target RedCard.
